message:
Congrat's.  I remember the first time I was published.  It was the summer of 1999 and I was serving...err...spending some time at a local correctional facility.  I had a lot of time on my hands so I concocted my own manifesto and it was published in oui and barely legal.  I was elated to say the least.

Ha!  Just kidding.  Congratulations, Mike.  I can't wait to read the reviews online...and you know there will eventually be a few student/reader reviews posted.
